name: miru
description: Semantic code search for coding agents. Find code by meaning, not grep.

benchmark.title: Benchmark mode
benchmark.description: Add a compact token-savings block to search/locate responses.

sagemaker_endpoint_arn.title: SageMaker endpoint ARN
sagemaker_endpoint_arn.description: Optional. Embed via your self-hosted SageMaker endpoint instead of Takara. Overrides any stored Takara sign-in. Leave blank to use Takara.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Name of an existing AWS profile in ~/.aws used to call the SageMaker endpoint. Only used with the endpoint ARN.
